note: A sheet set is what a job inspects against. Named by what it is, not by a code. `kind` tells the app which subject the sheet is about: a location (client/site/hazardous substance location), a handler (an applicant), or cylinders (a PCBU importing batches). `authorisation` points at the WorkSafe register entry that permits it; null means outside the certifier's authorisation and the app will not open a job on it.
